learning_outcomes.text: Acquire the basic concepts of business organization and managerial decision-making.
Understand the main organizational design principles.
Analyze business performance using accounting information.
Apply cost analysis techniques to support managerial decisions.
Evaluate investment decisions using the main financial appraisal methods.

syllabus_topics: The firm as an economic organization
assessment_rules: Assessment consists of two written examinations, corresponding to the two teaching modules, both held in a computer laboratory. The two examinations may be taken either in the same examination session or in different sessions. A passed module remains valid for the entire academic year, and students may repeat a previously passed module to improve their mark; in this case, the most recent result replaces the previous one. The final mark (out of 30) is obtained by combining the marks achieved in the two modules, both of which must be passed.
bibliography: R.N. Anthony, D.F. Hawkins, D.M. Macrì, K.A. Merchant – Il Bilancio. Analisi economiche per le decisioni e la comunicazione della performance , 16th ed., McGraw-Hill
